dct_title_s: Japan, Hokushu - South Coast. : Uchiura Wan or Iburi Wan (Volcano Bay)
dct_description_sm: Relief shown by contours, hachures, and spot heights.
Soundings in fathoms, heights in feet.
Conversion tables, tidal information, Japanese and English Terms.
Shows shoals, waterways, railways, roads, coastal/rural buildings.
